name: ernie45_rope_fused
description: ernie45_rope_fused(q, k, cos_sin_cache, positions, mrope_section, head_size, rotary_dim) -> (q_out, k_out). q is [T, n_qh*head_size], k is [T, n_kh*head_size], cos_sin_cache is [max_pos, rotary_dim], and positions is [3, T]. mrope_section is [section_h, section_w, section_t] with section_h == section_w and section_h + section_w + section_t == rotary_dim/2. For each token and rotary pair, the first section_hw = section_h + section_w pairs alternate height (even pair) and width (odd pair) positions, while the remaining pairs use the temporal position. Cos/sin values are gathered from the cache. Apply half-split RoPE to the first rotary_dim dimensions of every Q/K head: out1 = x1*cos - x2*sin and out2 = x2*cos + x1*sin; dimensions [rotary_dim, head_size) are copied unchanged. Returns newly allocated q_out and k_out with the input dtype and matching input shapes. No input mutation. The exercised dtype is bfloat16, with head_size equal to or larger than rotary_dim.
